rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Secure Exec exposes whitelisted shell commands to AI clients through a parameterized template engine, enforcing path traversal prevention, shell injection blocking, binary blacklisting, regex parameter validation, and rate limiting. It supports stdio and streamable HTTP transports, with comprehensive audit logging and a NixOS declarative systemd module.
